history:
It could be charged with the [[Critical Hits]] bonus by asking Yana for it till [[Updates/11.40|Summer Update 2017]]. There were three levels of charging:
*{{Ilink|Blade of Mayhem (Charged)}} [[Blade of Mayhem (Charged)]]
*{{Ilink|Blade of Mayhem (Heavily Charged)}} [[Blade of Mayhem (Heavily Charged)]]
*{{Ilink|Blade of Mayhem (Overcharged)}} [[Blade of Mayhem (Overcharged)]]
On the same update, this weapon received 3 imbuing slots and its attack and defense values were adjusted to the to values of its heavily charged version.

With the [[Updates/11.50|Winter Update 2017]], Blade of Carving, Blade of Mayhem and Blade of Remedy were merged into {{ilink|Blade of Destruction}} [[Blade of Destruction]].
name: Blade of Mayhem
notes: [[Yana]] will trade you one for 50 [[Gold Token]]s.
